lines.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਰੰਗਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: baran na saakau tumare ra(n)gaa gun nidhaan sukhadaate ||
lines.translation: I cannot describe Your Manifestations, O Treasure of Excellence, O Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar prabh abinaasee poore gur te jaate ||2||
lines.translation: God is Inaccessible, Incomprehensible and Imperishable; He is known through the Perfect Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਕੀਏ ਨਿਹਕੇਵਲ ਜਬ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhau kaat keee nihakeval jab te haumai maaree ||
lines.translation: My doubt and fear have been taken away, and I have been made pure, since my ego was conquered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੋ ਚੂਕੋ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: janam maran ko chooko sahasaa saadhasa(n)gat darasaaree ||3||
lines.translation: My fear of birth and death has been abolished, beholding Your Blessed Vision in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਪਖਾਰਿ ਕਰਉ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਲਖ ਬਰੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan pakhaar karau gur sevaa baar jaau lakh bareeaa ||
lines.translation: I wash the Guru's Feet and serve Him; I am a sacrifice to Him, 100,000 times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਰੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: jih prasaad ihu bhaujal tariaa jan naanak pri sa(n)g mireeaa ||4||7||128||
lines.translation: By His Grace, servant Nanak has crossed over this terrifying world-ocean; I am united with my Beloved. ||4||7||128||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਰੀਝਾਵੈ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin kavan reejhaavai tohee ||
lines.translation: Who can please You, except You Yourself?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tero roop sagal dekh mohee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon Your Beauteous Form, all are entranced. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਇਆਲ ਮਿਰਤ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਰਬ ਸਮਾਨੋ ਏਕੈ ਓਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: surag paiaal mirat bhoo ma(n)dal sarab samaano ekai ohee ||
lines.translation: In the heavenly paradise, in the nether regions of the underworld, on the planet earth and throughout the galaxies, the One Lord is pervading everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤ ਸਗਲ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਮਇਆ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇਰੀ ਦੋਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: siv siv karat sagal kar jorahi sarab maiaa thaakur teree dohee ||1||
lines.translation: Everyone calls upon You with their palms pressed together, saying, "Shiva, Shiva". O Merciful Lord and Master, everyone cries out for Your Help. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੀਤਲੋਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit paavan thaakur naam tumaraa sukhadaaee niramal seetalohee ||
lines.translation: Your Name, O Lord and Master, is the Purifier of sinners, the Giver of peace, immaculate, cooling and soothing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਸਿਉ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਹੀ ॥੨॥੮॥੧੨੯॥
lines.transliteration: giaan dhiaan naanak vadiaaee sa(n)t tere siu gaal galohee ||2||8||129||
lines.translation: O Nanak, spiritual wisdom, meditation and glorious greatness come from dialogue and discourse with Your Saints. ||2||8||129||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: milahu piaare jeeaa ||
lines.translation: Meet with me, O my Dear Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਥੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh keeaa tumaaraa theeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O God, whatever You do - that alone happens. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਬਹੁ ਜੋਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: anik janam bahu jonee bhramiaa bahur bahur dukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Wandering around through countless incarnations, I endured pain and suffering in so many lives, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree kripaa te maanukh deh paaee hai dehu daras har raaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: By Your Grace, I obtained this human body; grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, O Sovereign Lord King. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee hoaa jo tis bhaanaa avar na kin hee keetaa ||
lines.translation: That which pleases His Will has come to pass; no one else can do anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜਾਗਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੂਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tumarai bhaanai bharam mohi mohiaa jaagat naahee sootaa ||2||
lines.translation: By Your Will, enticed by the illusion of emotional attachment, the people are asleep; they do not wake up. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਉ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: binau sunahu tum praanapat piaare kirapaa nidh daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: Please hear my prayer, O Lord of Life, O Beloved, Ocean of mercy and compassion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਅਨਾਥਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: raakh lehu pitaa prabh mere anaathah kar pratipaalaa ||3||
lines.translation: Save me, O my Father God. I am an orphan - please, cherish me! ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no tumahi dikhaaio darasan saadhasa(n)gat kai paachhai ||
lines.translation: You reveal the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, for the sake of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧੂਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਇਹੁ ਬਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa dhoor dehu sa(n)tan kee sukh naanak ihu baachhai ||4||9||130||
lines.translation: Grant Your Grace, and bless us with the dust of the feet of the Saints; Nanak yearns for this peace. ||4||9||130||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau taa kai balihaaree ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa kai keval naam adhaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: who take the Support of the Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਗਨੀਐ ਜਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahimaa taa kee ketak ganeeai jan paarabraham ra(n)g raate ||
lines.translation: How can I recount the praises of those humble beings who are attuned to the Love of the Supreme Lord God?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਨ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਦਾਤੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d tinaa sa(n)g un samasar avar na daate ||1||
lines.translation: Peace, intuitive poise and bliss are with them. There are no other givers equal to them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣ ਸੇਈ ਆਏ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਦਰਸ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat udhaaran seee aae jo jan daras piaasaa ||
lines.translation: They have come to save the world - those humble beings who thirst for His Blessed Vision.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੈ ਸੋ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: un kee saran parai so tariaa sa(n)tasa(n)g pooran aasaa ||2||
lines.translation: Those who seek their Sanctuary are carried across; in the Society of the Saints, their hopes are fulfilled. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਰਣਿ ਪਰਉ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kai charan parau taa jeevaa jan kai sa(n)g nihaalaa ||
lines.translation: If I fall at their Feet, then I live; associating with those humble beings, I remain happy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਹੋਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhagatan kee ren hoi man meraa hohu prabhoo kirapaalaa ||3||
lines.translation: O God, please be merciful to me, that my mind might become the dust of the feet of Your devotees. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਅਵਧ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਘਾਟਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaj joban avadh jo deesai sabh kichh jug mahi ghaatiaa ||
lines.translation: Power and authority, youth and age - whatever is seen in this world, all of it shall fade away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਸਦ ਨਵਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਾਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੩੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan sad navatan niramal ihu naanak har dhan khaatiaa ||4||10||131||
lines.translation: The treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is forever new and immaculate. Nanak has earned this wealth of the Lord. ||4||10||131||
